name: Lesser Goldfinch
desc: Lesser Goldfinch (Spinus psaltria): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 399 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The lesser goldfinch is a small finch in the genus Spinus native to the Americas. As is the case for most species in the genus Spinus, lesser goldfinch males have a black forehead, which females lack.
